value.method: Algebra-owned lexical HTML scan with quote-aware tags and attributes; nonempty text and every attribute, including id are observed. Only exact element selector and property references are reconciled. No equality-based intent inference or ancestor/subtree coverage.
value.boundary: This scans the five generated homepage documents, not every corpus destination or live DOM state. Comments, doctype and formatting whitespace are excluded. Inline script/style bodies and external script/stylesheet dependencies are opaque and remain undecided unless precisely declared. CSS internals, runtime-only states, shadow DOM, frames and semantic/visual fitness are not certified. Token ordinals are byte-rendering evidence addresses, not stable DOM paths.

value.description: Scoped assurance topics, evidence maturity and the next work needed to strengthen each claim.

children: Assurance is a collection of questions about a product. Each topic declares its scope, shows its evidence and keeps its unfinished work visible.
review rows; open work remains visible in the detailed report.
This topic has its own evidence gates, scope and roadmap.
From assurance to a product roadmap
A roadmap item names the evidence needed for the next level. Product maturity is a profile across topics, with scope and open work alongside each level.
Explore maturity profiles and the evidence roadmap →
Download topics, levels and roadmap evidence ↗
Ready for other languages and locales?
The current assessment covers five homepage entry routes. Levels describe evidence maturity within that scope; every topic keeps its own requirements and open work.

The automatic checks cover document language markers, a skip link with its target and image alt-attribute presence. Alternative-text meaning, focus order, keyboard operation, assistive technology, reflow and visual contrast remain evaluation work. WCAG conformance requires a separate scoped evaluation.

Language and UTF-8 markers are observed. Supported locale commitments, message/content externalisation, locale selection, fallback, formatting and text direction have not been evidenced by this assessment. Linguistic and cultural review are later obligations.
Human and audience evaluation receipts have not been recorded for this saga.

value.title: Product maturity & evidence roadmap — Aaron Alderman
value.description: A scoped maturity profile by assurance saga, and the evidence work needed to advance it.

children: Each product has a profile across assurance topics. The level records the evidence available for a stated scope; open obligations remain visible.

A catalogue label such as “Live example” or “In progress” describes delivery. It does not establish an assurance level. “Unassessed” records the absence of an assessment, without judging a product’s underlying quality.
The website row covers homepage entry routes only. The catalogue products have not been assessed by this offering.
. Owner assignment and delivery dates remain open.

Every required gate at a level and every earlier level needs matching evidence. Missing, failed, ambiguous or differently scoped receipts block promotion. New evidence can lower a level when a required check fails. Source, issuer, method and observation date accompany each accepted receipt; those fields alone do not authenticate an evaluation.
